decision_scope: APPROVE_OR_REVISE_ONLY_THE_6_SURFACE_CANDIDATE_PROPOSAL_DECISIONS_AND_GOVERNANCE_BOUNDARIES; IF_APPROVED_CREATE_ONLY_THE_SEPARATE L03 CANDIDATE ARTIFACT; DO_NOT_AUTHOR OPI QA STRUCTURES OR ASSIGN CURRICULUM SLOTS WITH THE SAME APPROVAL

governance_decisions.statement: Proposal approval may create only one scoped microgrammar candidate artifact; it does not make the pattern productive or validated and does not author curriculum slots.
VALI and PARAZAMI remain lexemes with their existing authority labels; the new CANDIDATE concerns only their scoped use as complete controlled activity utterances.
Do not introduce AN, EN, KE, NE, KU, KUVAN, SARU, SALI, DAYI or TA into this first candidate.
Do not infer first person, zero pronoun, tense, aspect, modality, habituality, frequency, negation or interrogative grammar from the proposed surface schema.
The candidate must explicitly state NEW_AUTHORED_CANDIDATE, L03-only scope, no historical recovery claim and no universal HNK grammar claim.
If approved, create the candidate artifact only and open a separate human gate before validation, productivity promotion, OPI/QA/Structures authoring or slot assignment.
